notes: *nothing* fuses לֹא and כֹּל under rule 35, headed on the negative; the competing reading gives *nothing* to the negative alone and leaves כֹּל unrepresented, which rule 35 forbids where one English word answers to two morphemes.
`נְשָׁמָה` keeps the supplied relative of *that breatheth* in its own unit (rule 46), and `תְחַיֶּה` heads on the complement *alive* (rule 44).
